verses.en: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel.
verses.sm: Esekia Ua alu le feau a Esekia ia Isaraelu uma atoa ma Iuta, ma ua tusi atu tusi ia Efaraima ma Manase, ia o mai i latou i le fale o le ALII i Ierusalema, e fai le paseka i le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu.

verses.en: For the king had taken counsel, and his princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, to keep the passover in the second month.
verses.sm: Aua na filifili e le tupu, ma alii sa ia te ia, ma le faapotopotoga uma i Ierusalema, e fai ai le paseka i le lua o masina.

verses.en: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves sufficiently, neither had the people gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Aua ua le mafai ona fai ai i ia ona po, aua o le au faitaulaga e lei uma ona faapaiaina i latou e i latou; o le nuu foi e lei faapotopotoina i latou i Ierusalema.

verses.en: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation.
verses.sm: Ua tonu lenei mea i le manatu o le tupu atoa ma le manatu o le faapotopotoga uma.

verses.en: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beer-sheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel at Jerusalem: for they had not done it of a long time in such sort as it was written.
verses.sm: Ua latou faamauina le filifiliga e tala‘i atu ia Isaraelu uma e gata mai i Peresepa e gata mai i Tanu, ia o mai i latou e fai le paseka i le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu i Ierusalema; aua ua latou le faia tele pei ona tusia.

verses.en: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, Ye children of Israel, turn again unto the LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and he will return to the remnant of you, that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.
verses.sm: Ua o atu ma tusi a le tupu ma alii sa ia te ia o e avea feau ia Isaraelu uma atoa ma Iuta, e tusa foi ma le poloaiga a le tupu, ua faapea atu, Le fanauga a Isaraelu e, ia outou toe foi mai i le ALII le Atua o Aperaamo, ma Isaako, ma Isaraelu, ona toe foi mai lea o ia ia te outou o totoe, ua sao i lima o tupu o Asuria.

verses.en: And be not ye like your fathers, and like your brethren, which trespassed against the LORD God of their fathers, who therefore gave them up to desolation, as ye see.
verses.sm: Aua ne“ faapei o outou tama outou, ma faapei o outou uso, na agasala atu i le ALII le Atua o latou tama, ona tuuina atu ai lea o i latou e ia ia faatafunaina, e pei ona outou iloa atu.

verses.en: Now be ye not stiffnecked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves unto the LORD, and enter into his sanctuary, which he hath sanctified for ever: and serve the LORD your God, that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you.
verses.sm: O lenei, aua le faamaaa o outou ua, e pei o outou tamá; ja outou tuuina atu outou i le ALII, ma o mai i lona malumalu ua faapaiaina e ia e faavavau; ma ia auauna i le ALII lo outou Atua, ina ia liliu ese ai ia te outou lona teasa tele.

verses.en: For if ye turn again unto the LORD, your brethren and your children shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for the LORD your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.
verses.sm: Afai tou te toe foi mai i le ALII e alofaina ai o outou uso, ma a outou fanau i luma o e ua faatagataotauaina i latou, ma latou toe foi mai i lenei lava nuu; aua o le ALII o lo outou Atua e alofa fua ma alofa mutimuti vale, e le “alo foi ona fofoga ia te outou, pe afai tou te toe foi mai ia te ia.

verses.en: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.
verses.sm: Ona w atu ai lea o e avea feau i lea aai ma lea aai i le nuu o Efaraima ma Manase, e oo atu lava i Sepulona; a ua latou tapisa ia te i latou, ma faatauemu ia te i latou.

verses.en: Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.sm: A e peitai o isi tagata o Asera, ma Manase, ma Sepulona, ua latou faamaulalo, ma ua o mai ai i lerusalema.

verses.en: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of the LORD.
verses.sm: Sa iai foi ia Tuta le aao o le Atua e foai mai ia te i latou le loto gatasi ina ia faia le poloaiga a le tupu ma alii, e tusa ma le afioga a le- Arı.

verses.en: And there assembled at Jerusalem much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.
verses.sm: Ona faapotopoto lea o tagata e toatele i Jerusalema, e fai ai le tausamiga O areto e le faafefeteina i le lua o masina, o le faapotopotoga e matua tele lava.

verses.en: And they arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast them into the brook Kidron.
verses.sm: Ona tuti ai lea o i latou i luga, ma latou aveeseina fata faitaulaga sa i Ierusalema, ma fata uma e faamu ai mea manogi ua latou aveeseina, ma latou lafo atu ai i le alia o Ketarono.

verses.en: Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the second month: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua latou fasia foi le paseka i le sefulu ma le fa o aso o le lua o masina; sa masiasi foi le au faitaulaga ma sa Levi, ona latou faapaiaina lea o i latou, ma au mai ai o taulaga mu i le fale o le ALn.

verses.en: And they stood in their place after their manner, according to the law of Moses the man of God: the priests sprinkled the blood, which they received of the hand of the Levites.
verses.sm: Ua tutū i latou i le mea e tutū ai i latou E pei o a latou masani, e tusa ma le tulafono a Mose le tagata o le Atua; ua sausau foi le toto e le au faitaulaga, na latou talia mai lima o sa Levi.

verses.en: For there were many in the congregation that were not sanctified: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one that was not clean, to sanctify them unto the LORD.
verses.sm: Aua ua toatele i le faapotopotoga e lei faapaiaina; ua fasia foi e sa Levi o paseka mo i latou uma ua le mamā, ina ia faapaiaina i latou i le ALı1.

verses.en: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, and Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet did they eat the passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, The good LORD pardon every one
verses.sm: Anae toatele o le nuu, e toatele mai Efaraima, ma Manase, ma Isakara, ma Sepulona, ua latou le faamamā ia te i latou, a ua latou aai le paseka e le tusa ma le ua tusia. A ua tatalo Esekia mo i latou, ua faapea atu, la faamagalo mai e le ALn lē agalelei,

verses.en: That prepareth his heart to seek God, the LORD God of his fathers, though he be not cleansed according to the purification of the sanctuary.
verses.sm: ia i latou uma lava o e saunia o latou loto e sailiili i le Atua, o le ALn le Atua o latou tamā, e ui lava ina ua le faamamaina e tusa ma le faamamaina o le malumalu.

verses.en: And the LORD hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.
verses.sm: Ua faafofogaina Esekia e le AL11, ma ua faamaloloina e ia le nuu.

verses.en: And the children of Israel that were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness: and the Levites and the priests praised the LORD day by day, singing with loud instruments unto the LORD.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Isaraelu na i ai i Ierusalema na faia e i latou le tausamiga o areto e lei faafefeteina ma le fiafia tele lava i aso e fitu; na vivii atu foi sa Levi ma le au faitaulaga i le ALn i lea aso ma lea aso i laaupese e vivii atu a“ i le AL11.

verses.en: And Hezekiah spake comfortably unto all the Levites that taught the good knowledge of the LORD: and they did eat throughout the feast seven days, offering peace offerings, and making confession to the LORD God of their fathers.
verses.sm: Ua faamafamafana atu Esekia i sa Levi uma o e na aʻoaʻo ia mafaufau lelei i le AL11; ua latou aai foi i le tausamiga i aso c fitu, o fai taulaga faafetai, ma latou faafetai atu i le ALn le Atua o latou tama.

verses.en: And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days: and they kept other seven days with gladness.
verses.sm: Ona filifili lea e le faapotopotoga uma e fai le tausamiga i nisi aso e fitu; ona latou faia lea i nisi aso e fitu ma le fiafia.

verses.en: For Hezekiah king of Judah did give to the congregation a thousand bullocks and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the congregation a thousand bullocks and ten thousand sheep: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.
verses.sm: Auā na avatua e Esekia le tupu o Iuta i le faapotopotoga o povi poa e tasi le afe, ma mamoe e fitu afe; na avatua foi e alii i le faapotopotoga o povi poa e tasi le afe, ma mamoe e sefulu afe; e toatele foi o le au faitaulaga na faapaiaina i latou e i latou.

verses.en: And all the congregation of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Israel, and the strangers that came out of the land of Israel, and that dwelt in Judah, rejoiced.
verses.sm: Ua fiafia le faapotopotoga uma o Iuta, atoa ma le au faitaulaga ma sa Levi, ma le faapotopotoga uma na o mai nai Isaraelu, ma tagata ese na o mai nai le nuu o Isaraelu, ma e sa nonofo i Iuta.

verses.en: So there was great joy in Jerusalem: for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was not the like in Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Sa i ai foi le fiafia tele i Ierusalema; aua e lei i ai se mea faapea i Ierusalema talu ona po o Solomona le atalii o Tavita le tupu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy dwelling place, even unto heaven.
verses.sm: Ona tuta ai lea o le au faitaulaga, o sa Levi, ma latou faamanuia atu i le nuu; sa faafofogaina foi e le ALII o latouleo, ma ua 00 atu a latou tatalo i lona afioaga paia, o le lagi lava.
